results.title: WHO approves clinical trials on two new Ebola vaccines
results.content: The World Health Organization on Wednesday approved clinical trials for two new Ebola vaccines, as doctors fight to control an outbreak in Africa that has killed more than 5,300 people

results.title: Libya's eastern administration appoints a new central bank governor
results.content: The former governor, Naji Issa, submitted his resignation to the two legislative chambers in August without publicly explaining his reasons.

results.title: Brazil: Santa Claus School celebrates graduation at Christ the Redeemer
results.content: Dozens of Santas gathered at Rio de Janeiro's iconic Christ the Redeemer statue to celebrate their graduation. The 55 new recruits are preparing to spread Christmas cheer across Brazil.

results.title: Iran's leaders say midterm results show voters have rejected Trump's war
results.content: Iranians on Wednesday struck a defiant tone, celebrating U.S. voters’ rebuke of President Donald Trump in the midterm elections while many in the Middle East waited to see how the results could affect the Iran war

results.title: UK: Police arrest Palestine Action supporters outside Supreme Court
results.content: Police arrested supporters of Palestine Action outside the Supreme Court in London, United Kingdom, on Wednesday 4 November, as a legal battle over the British government's ban on the group resumed.

results.title: Global travel could hit record levels despite wars and rising fuel costs
results.content: The World Travel Market global report says tourists are likely to spend 23.9 billion nights on vacation in 2026, with total visitor spending of $7.8 trillion.

results.title: Ukraine: Police footage captures Russian strike on Komyshuvakha shelter
results.content: Bodycam footage from a police officer killed in the attack captures the moments before a Russian bomb strikes a shelter in Komyshuvakha, in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region, killing at least 37 people.

results.title: Egyptian president calls Iran, US to resolve conflict
results.content: Egyptian president Abdel-Fattah el-Sissi on Tuesday called on Iran and the United States to engage in dialogue and reach an agreement to resolve their ongoing conflict, warning against further military escalation in the region.

results.title: South Africans vote in local elections with ANC missteps in sharp focus
results.content: South Africans are voting Wednesday in local elections that are expected to be a tough test for the African National Congress party, which led the country out of white minority rule but has seen a consistent decline in support over the last decade

results.title: Senegal's National Assembly rejects key budget bill after heated disputes
results.content: Senegal's National Assembly, which is dominated by the opposition, rejected a key budget bill Tuesday, a text that was seen as crucial to restoring public finances as the country finalises an IMF bailout.

results.title: Cyril Ramaphosa casts vote in tense municipal elections
results.content: South Africans voted on Wednesday in a closely watched local government election, with parties battling for control of major cities in a contest expected to offer a measure of the national mood before the next national polls.

results.title: South Africa: Exclusion from AGOA does not mean end of trade with US
results.content: Experts say only about 10 per cent of South Africa’s exports to the US are currently subject to AGOA, representing about 1 per cent of it total global exports.

results.title: Niger signs cooperation deal with military leader in eastern Libya
results.content: The agreement to expand cooperation in “various fields” was approved by Nigerien Prime Minister Ali Maha-man Lamine Zeine during a visit to Benghazi.

results.title: Kenya’s Phoebe Okowa elected to International Court of Justice
results.content: Okowa won 183 votes in the General Assembly and 13 in the Security Council. She is a professor of public international law at Queen Mary University of London and has served on the UN’s International Law Commission since 2021.

results.title: Haitian PM thanks El Salvador for support in fight against gangs
results.content: El Salvador sent more than 2,000 soldiers to Haiti, the government said Wednesday, to support a mission to rescue four soldiers serving in a UN-backed force missing after an ambush.

results.title: Portugal: Housing protesters return to Lisbon square after court ruling
results.content: Housing protesters have returned to Lisbon's historic Rossio Square, setting up around 100 tents following a court ruling. The demonstration comes as Portugal's government faces growing pressure over housing.

results.title: Ukraine: 33 dead, over 50 missing after Russian bombing in Zaporizhzhia
results.content: Russian strikes on a humanitarian aid site in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region have killed 33 people, with more than 50 still missing, on Monday 2 November. Survivors and rescuers are being treated for severe injuries.

results.title: Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms becomes first Black woman governor in US history
results.content: Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms, a former Atlanta mayor, won the race for governor in the southern state of Georgia on Tuesday, making her the first Black woman elected to the top office in any US state, media projections showed.

results.title: Democrats seize Congress as Trump refuses to take blame
results.content: President Donald Trump had rare praise for rival Democrats Tuesday after their stunning US midterm elections victory and admitted the Iran war may have played a part in the defeat of his Republican Party.

results.title: US midterm elections: Cheers erupt as Talarico's Texas victory is projected
results.content: Supporters erupted in celebration in Austin as Democrat James Talarico was projected to win a US Senate seat in Texas, a state where his party has not won a Senate election since 1988.

results.title: US requires air passengers to attest they haven’t visited Ebola-hit DRC
results.content: US-bound air passengers must sign a statement that they have not travelled to the Democratic Republic of Congo, the epicentre of a deadly Ebola outbreak, under new rules coming into force on Tuesday, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

results.title: South Africans vote amid growing discontent over failing services and infrastructure
results.content: South Africans head to the polls on Wednesday for local government elections, with voters set to choose their municipal representatives amid growing concerns over unemployment, crime, water shortages and the delivery of basic services.

results.title: UN peacekeeping head meets leaders of rebel coalition in eastern DRC
results.content: The head of the UN’s MONUSCO peacekeeping mission to Congo met with the DRC’s former president Joseph Kabila on Tuesday and other leaders of his new coalition.

results.title: King Charles addresses 'monstrous injustice' of slavery as UK PM mulls apology
results.content: The transatlantic slave trade was a ‘monstrous injustice,’ Britain’s King Charles III said on Tuesday in a speech to Commonwealth leaders. But he stopped short of an apology.

results.title: Disruptions to basic services loom over South Africa's local polls
results.content: As voters in Johannesburg ready for Wednesday’s local elections, basic services are top of their concerns. South Africa’s economic capital and largest city, Johannesburg has seen nearly two weeks of disruption to its water supply, with severe outages and low pressure in parts of the city.

results.title: Tenerife footballer Jesús De Miguel dies aged 30 after match collision
results.content: The Spanish player had a cardiac arrest after he was struck in the chest when challenging the ball.

results.title: South Africa's first bread sommelier perfects centuries-old tradition
results.content: A centuries-old Cape Winelands tradition is now on the global culinary map. Mosbolletjies is a traditional brioche made with grape must. Now a recipe for the bread created by a South African baker has won him the title of Bread Sommelier.

results.title: Egypt: 104th anniversary of the discovery of King Tutankhamun's tomb
results.content: The unearthing of his 3,000 year-old tomb and all its treasures is seen as one of the greatest archaeological discoveries of all time.
